question: What power to shake the triple world arises from continually contemplating a smoke-colored form?
premises: One contemplates a smoke-colored form always
The practitioner gains the power to shake it
inference: By continually contemplating a smoke-colored form, one can shake the triple world
uncertainties: The object contemplated as smoke-colored is not explicitly named and may be the world or a deity
plain_english: O beloved, by always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one can shake the triple world.
